main:
 # Create your account
 form:
  ## Personal details
  textbox "First name" [e1] required
  textbox "Last name" [e2] required
  textbox "Email" [e3] required
  textbox "Phone" [e4]
  date "Date of birth" [e5] required
  date "Preferred call time" [e6]
  ## Address
  textbox "Street address" [e7]
  textbox "City" [e8]
  textbox "Postal code" [e9]
  combobox "Country" [e10] = "Select a country..." options: Select a country...|Australia|Canada|France|Germany|Ireland|Portugal|United Kingdom|United States required
  ## Account
  group "Account type":
   Account type
   radio "Personal" [e11] checked
   radio "Business" [e12]
   radio "Non-profit" [e13]
  combobox "Plan" [e14] = "Free" options: Free|Pro - billed monthly|Pro - billed annually|Enterprise
  spinbutton "Seats" [e15] = "1"
  group "Interests":
   Interests
   checkbox "Analytics" [e16]
   checkbox "Automation" [e17]
   checkbox "Billing" [e18] checked
   checkbox "Security" [e19]
  group "Preferred contact method":
   Preferred contact method
   radio "Email" [e20] checked
   radio "Phone" [e21]
   radio "SMS" [e22]
  textbox "About you" [e23]
  checkbox "Send me the monthly newsletter" [e24] checked
  checkbox "I accept the terms of service" [e25] required
  button "Create account" [e26]
